body:
Two numbers decide your total at checkout at One Stop Vape Store: the minimum order and the free-shipping threshold. They are simple on their own, but they interact with the 10% discount for cryptocurrency and gift cards in a way that surprises many customers. This guide explains both numbers, how the discount changes the free-shipping check, which areas are excluded from free shipping, how to plan your cart to land on the best total and what to do if you are close to a threshold. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Minimum order: $100
Checkout requires a product subtotal of at least $100 before any discount. The cart page shows how much more you need if you fall short, and checkout will not complete until you reach it. The minimum applies to the value of the products, not to shipping or tax. It exists so that we can keep wholesale-competitive pricing and process orders efficiently. If you only need a small amount, consider combining a few items you will use over time, or ordering together with a friend.

## Free shipping: $200 or more after discount
Free domestic shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax, for most of the 48 contiguous U.S. states. Orders below that pay the flat shipping fee shown in your order summary, currently $15. The check is made on the amount after any discount, and before any tax, so the order summary always shows exactly what will be charged. If your order qualifies, shipping shows as free in the summary, and if it does not, the flat fee is added to the total.

## How the 10% discount interacts
If you pay with cryptocurrency or a supported gift card, you get 10% off the product subtotal, and the free-shipping check is applied after that discount. This is the part that surprises people. A $210 cart paid with crypto becomes $189.00 after the discount, which is under $200, so it does not qualify and the $15 fee is added, making $204.00. The same $210 cart paid with Cash App has no discount, stays above $200 and ships free, so it totals $210.00. Read the full explanation in [how the 10% discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Worked examples
- **$100 cart, Cash App:** no discount, under $200, so $100.00 plus $15.00 shipping is $115.00.
- **$100 cart, crypto:** $10.00 discount gives $90.00, plus $15.00 shipping, so $105.00.
- **$150 cart, Cash App:** $150.00 plus $15.00 is $165.00.
- **$150 cart, crypto:** $135.00 plus $15.00 is $150.00.
- **$200 cart, Cash App:** exactly $200, so shipping is free and the total is $200.00.
- **$200 cart, crypto:** $180.00 after discount is under $200, so $15.00 is added, giving $195.00. Crypto is still $5.00 cheaper.
- **$215 cart, crypto:** $193.50 after discount, so $15.00 is added, giving $208.50. Compare Cash App at $215.00 with free shipping: crypto is $6.50 cheaper.
- **$230 cart, crypto:** $207.00 after discount, so shipping is free, and the total is $207.00. Cash App is $230.00.
- **$300 cart, crypto:** $270.00 after discount, shipping free, total $270.00.

In almost every case the discount still beats the flat fee, but the saving shrinks when the discount pushes you under the free-shipping line.

## Where free shipping does not apply
Free shipping is valid for most of the 48 contiguous U.S. states. It does not apply to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands or APO, DPO, FPO and other U.S. military addresses. We do not ship internationally, and orders placed with an international address will be cancelled and refunded. See [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## How to plan your cart
1. **Decide your payment method first,** because the discount changes the maths.
2. **Look at the order summary** for each method and compare totals.
3. **If you are just under a threshold,** consider whether one more item gets you over it.
4. **If the discount drops you under $200,** compare the final totals before you pay.
5. **If you need only a little more to reach $100,** add a small item you will use.

Combining items to cross a threshold is also a good way to stock up. See [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/).

## Does the minimum include the discount?
No. The $100 minimum is checked on the product subtotal before the discount. A $100 cart paid with crypto is allowed, and the discount takes it to $90.00 before shipping.

## Is tax included in the check?
Free shipping is measured after discount and before tax, so tax does not push you over or under the line. Any tax that applies is shown in your order summary before you pay.

## Do options and quantities count?
Yes. The subtotal is the sum of every line at the price for the option you chose, multiplied by the quantity. If you change a strength or pack size on a product page, the line price changes, and so does the subtotal.

## Common questions
### Can I split an order to get free shipping twice?
Free shipping is measured per order. Splitting a larger order into two smaller ones usually costs more, because each could fall under the threshold and each pays shipping. Keep it as one order where you can.

### What if my cart is just under $200?
Check whether adding a small item gets you over the line. If you are paying with crypto or a gift card, remember that the check is after the discount, so you need a subtotal of about $222.23 or more to reach $200 after a 10% discount.

### Does shipping speed change with the free option?
No. Free and paid shipping use the same processing time of 24 to 72 business hours and the same regional carriers. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

### Is the minimum order negotiable for retailers?
Wholesale orders are arranged separately. See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) and [how to become a wholesale customer](/blog/how-to-become-a-wholesale-customer/).

## Why the rules exist
The minimum order lets us offer competitive pricing and process orders efficiently. The free-shipping line rewards larger orders, which cost less to ship per item. Measuring free shipping after the discount keeps the offer consistent whichever method you use: it depends on what you actually pay for products, not on a list price.

## Putting it together
Pick your items, choose the options you want, compare the order summary for each payment method and choose the one that costs you least while suiting your habits. If you are close to a threshold, a small change can save you the shipping fee. For help, message us through the [contact page](/contact/) before you pay. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## More ways to think about your total
### Compare the cost per item, not only the total
A larger order spreads the shipping fee across more items. If you are paying $15 on a $100 order, shipping adds 15% to the cost. On a $200 order that ships free, it adds nothing. Thinking in terms of cost per item makes it easier to decide whether to add a few more products now or order again later. If you vape regularly and the products keep well, a larger order less often is usually the better value. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/) and [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/) so that stock stays in good condition.

### Do not buy what you will not use
It is tempting to add filler to reach $200. Choose items you will actually use, because an unused product is wasted money, and opened items cannot be returned. If you are a few dollars short, a small accessory or a spare pod you will need anyway is a better choice than something you are unsure about.

### Remember that options change the price
If you choose a larger pack size or a different strength, the line price changes, and so does your subtotal. Check the order summary after you change an option, because it can move you across a threshold in either direction.

### Ask us if you are stuck
If you are close to a threshold and cannot decide, message us through the [contact page](/contact/) with what you want to buy. We will work through the numbers with you and point out whether a small change saves the shipping fee.

### A quick formula for the free-shipping line
If you are paying by crypto or gift card, divide $200 by 0.9 to find the subtotal you need: about $222.23. If you are paying by Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime, you need a subtotal of $200. Keep those two numbers in mind when you plan a cart, and check the order summary to confirm. If you are somewhere between the two, the app route may give free shipping while the discounted route adds the $15 fee, and the discounted route can still be cheaper overall, so always compare the final totals rather than guessing.

### What if I am ordering for a group?
Some customers combine an order with friends or colleagues to reach $200 or more and share the shipping saving. If you do, make sure one adult will receive and sign for the parcel, and agree who pays what before you order, because each order has a single payment method and a single delivery address.
